answer_2.quote: We adopt Air-Bench to evaluate the capabilities of LALMs on speech chatting measured by Helpfulness Score (HS) ranging from 0 to 10. Attack Success Rate (ASR %) measures the percentage of harmful responses... Overrejection Rate (ORR %) calculates the percentage of refusal responses to benign questions.
